validation.production: Eight production file hashes match; runtime catalog active/public at 62500000 PVE and zero PVP; foundation marker complete; X-BODY preserved at 50000000; no ownership grants.

release.integrated: Preserved nurse healing nerf 476ededc and deployment record b3a20820; rebuilt ten V3 consumers from merged source.
release.rationale: One new approved suit uses the established catalog and PVE rendering/scheduler extension points. No schema, transaction infrastructure, authentication, dependencies or launch gates were changed. Existing suit regressions and atomic catalog retry tests passed. Retain results for unchanged source and run final main-loader regression and required compiler/release/cache/Hyperdrive checks through designated scoped deployment.

runtimeCacheFix.rootCause: The main entry versioned the new engine but reused the pre-Overlord wrapper URL. That cached wrapper could reload its cached pre-Overlord engine. The readiness gate also accepted an already loaded old pair because they agreed with each other.
changes: Version lobby, engine and wrapper together with overlord=20261005-v2.
Require both wrapper and engine to match the lobby expected runtime.
Refresh native PVE and sustained PVE entry URLs, including the nested native loader.
preserved: Approved artwork, sword motion, title and aura
CMS balance; read-only live check found 75000000 PVE and preserved it

verification.before: All three checks failed; actual browser reproduced visible gun, no sword controller and no title using the historical wrapper and engine.
verification.after: Three cache checks passed. Actual lobby loader on PC/mobile selected Overlord V6; no generic gun; crimson aura and title visible; sword damage receipts replayed exactly (115176).

release.reason: Fix only battle entry cache compatibility for the approved Overlord; no assets, engine simulation, transactions or balance changes.
